scope: Independent public USGS hydrography, no fish records; not a reconstruction of the original 22 survey reaches, no post-response access, no EOG-WF endpoint
checks: provider query succeeds and no exceededTransferLimit; nonempty response; field names validated case-insensitively
unique positive integer exact node and reach IDs, positive finite lengths, one common GNIS ID and name, with-digitized flowdir=1; no self loops

build hydrologically directed reach-edge graph by exact fromnode/tonode IDs; independently test DNHydroSeq where named downstream reach present; no nearest-neighbor snapping, no assumption of single chain
named-river extraction only: gaps may reflect unnamed segments or network boundaries; no claim of full basin or confirmed surveyed-reach crosswalk; no use of present-day flowlines as historical truth
report edges, nodes, weak components, branching, terminal nodes, cycles and summed provider length; no fish responses, species passability or hypothetical costs
output: canonical sanitized network JSON + report with raw response SHA-256 and metadata, no raw JSON required; fail closed on invalid schema/truncation, retain diagnostics; no geometry needed for topological first pass
stop: No retries of prior denied ScienceBase endpoint. If provider fails, record HOLD. No graph claims without result. No merge.
